changelog:
Initial release: content-marketer skill for content strategy and planning

- Provides a workflow for designing content strategies based on product positioning
- Includes templates for content matrix, topic planning, distribution strategies, and metrics tracking
- Supports content planning for major platforms (WeChat, Zhihu, Xiaohongshu, Douyin, etc.)
- Outputs ready-to-use marketing strategy documents in Markdown format
- Enforces best practices: concrete topics, platform-specific plans, clear performance metrics
